subject: CPhysical -- rigid-body base of every moving entity
_methodology: Primary: disassembly VALIDATE_OFFSET macros (compile-time assertions; authoritative). Secondary: disassembly Physical.h (flag names and bitfield layout). Tertiary: Capstone disassembly sweep of 18 CPhysical methods from gta_sa.exe (upgrades tier to verified_by_disassembly when offset appears in 2+ function bodies). m_nPhysicalFlags @0x40 was the critical discovery: 28 hits across 15 functions, missing from disassembly header which exposes it as anonymous bitfields.

fields.name: field_38
fields.note: purpose unknown; read in ApplyTurnForce + ApplyForce + ApplyMoveSpeed

fields.name: m_nLastCollisionTime
fields.note: game timer value at last collision frame

fields.name: m_nPhysicalFlags
fields.note: union of 32 physics behavior bitflags. Checked in almost every physics function to gate behaviour. Source: disassembly Physical.h + disassembly CPhysical.h bitfield declaration.

fields.name: m_vecMoveSpeed
fields.note: linear velocity (world-space). ApplyForce: m_vecMoveSpeed += force/mass

fields.name: m_vecTurnSpeed
fields.note: angular velocity (world-space). ApplyTurnForce: m_vecTurnSpeed += cross(r,F)/I

fields.name: m_vecFrictionMoveSpeed
fields.note: friction linear velocity accumulator

fields.name: m_vecFrictionTurnSpeed
fields.note: friction angular velocity accumulator

fields.name: m_vecForce
fields.note: accumulated force vector for current physics step (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed, not seen in Capstone sweep of 18 methods)

fields.name: m_vecTorque
fields.note: accumulated torque vector for current physics step (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_fMass
fields.note: mass in kg. ApplyForce: fld [esi+0x8C] then fdiv; semantic + literal confirmed

fields.name: m_fTurnMass
fields.note: angular inertia (moment of mass). ApplyTurnForce uses this to scale torque

fields.name: m_fVelocityFrequency
fields.note: velocity integration frequency scalar (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_fAirResistance
fields.note: air resistance coefficient, applied each frame in ApplyAirResistance (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_fElasticity
fields.note: coefficient of restitution [0..1]; 0=inelastic, 1=perfectly elastic (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_fBuoyancyConstant
fields.note: buoyancy force multiplier used in water submersion physics (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_vecCentreOfMass
fields.note: local-space centre of mass offset from model pivot; used in ApplyTurnForce cross product

fields.name: m_pCollisionList
fields.note: linked list of collision entries for this entity (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_pMovingList
fields.note: node in CWorld's moving entity list; set/cleared by AddToMovingList/RemoveFromMovingList

fields.name: m_nFakePhysics
fields.note: non-zero = simplified/fake physics mode (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_nNumEntitiesCollided
fields.note: count of entities in m_apCollidedEntities; used in AddCollisionRecord / SkipPhysics

fields.name: m_nContactSurface
fields.note: eSurfaceType of the surface last contacted (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: field_BB
fields.note: padding byte (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_apCollidedEntities
fields.note: array of up to 6 entities this entity collided with this frame

fields.name: m_fMovingSpeed
fields.note: scalar speed used by CTheScripts::IsVehicleStopped; updated each physics step (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_fDamageIntensity
fields.note: intensity of most recent collision damage; written by SetDamagedPieceRecord; cleared by SkipPhysics

fields.name: m_pDamageEntity
fields.note: entity that most recently caused damage to this physical

fields.name: m_vecLastCollisionImpactVelocity
fields.note: world-space velocity at last collision impact point; written by SetDamagedPieceRecord (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_vecLastCollisionPosn
fields.note: world-space position of last collision; written by SetDamagedPieceRecord (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_nPieceType
fields.note: fragment/piece type index of last damaged piece; used to select damage model

fields.name: field_FA
fields.note: padding to align m_pAttachedTo at 0xFC (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_pAttachedTo
fields.note: parent entity when attached; NULL when free. See AttachEntityToEntity / DettachEntityFromEntity (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_vecAttachOffset
fields.note: local offset from attach parent's pivot (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_vecAttachedEntityPosn
fields.note: cached world position of the attached entity (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_qAttachedEntityRotation
fields.note: cached rotation of attached entity as quaternion (x,y,z,w = 16 bytes; VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_pEntityIgnoredCollision
fields.note: collision with this entity is ignored (typically the attach parent; VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_fContactSurfaceBrightness
fields.note: lighting brightness from contact surface (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_fDynamicLighting
fields.note: accumulated dynamic lighting value for rendering (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

fields.name: m_pShadowData
fields.note: pointer to real-time shadow data; NULL if no shadow active (VALIDATE_OFFSET confirmed)

provenance: disassembly VALIDATE_OFFSET (authoritative) + disassembly Physical.h (bitfield names) + Capstone sweep of 18 CPhysical functions vs gta_sa.exe
